method: Googleyness: intellectual humility, navigating ambiguity, doing the right thing, collaborative problem solving
General Cognitive Ability (GCA): structured breakdown of unbounded problems from first principles
Role-Related Knowledge (RRK): rigorous algorithmic thinking, clean modular abstractions, and planetary scale system design

entry-level: Algorithmic precision: optimal time/space complexity with mathematical reasoning
Clean abstractions, testability, and edge-case rigor (nulls, overflows, boundaries)
Openness to hints, intellectual curiosity, and transparent thought process
mid-level: Deep understanding of distributed consensus, RPC frameworks (gRPC/Stubby), and caching layers
Designing services that scale smoothly with data volume and concurrent queries
Clear articulation of trade-offs between consistency, availability, and hardware cost
senior: Designing resilient planetary-scale distributed systems (Spanner/TrueTime, Bigtable, Colossus concepts)
High reliability engineering: cross-region replication, fault domains, and graceful degradation
Navigating complex ambiguous engineering mandates and driving consensus across diverse teams
staff-plus: Defining foundational technical standards and reusable infrastructure primitives across organizations
Setting long-term architectural visions for multi-billion request systems with strict safety guarantees
Exemplary leadership in technical mentorship, diversity, and engineering culture

swe: Scalable algorithms, memory layout awareness, concurrency primitives, and thread safety
Clean separation of API contracts, business logic, and durable storage
ml-data: Large-scale distributed training (TPU/GPU pods), embeddings search, vector indexing at scale
Model quantization, distillation, low-latency online serving, and data governance
sre-infra: SRE principles: error budgets, SLOs vs SLAs, toil automation, canary releases, and postmortems without blame
Distributed tracing (Dapper), Borg/Kubernetes cluster scheduling, and global traffic management
pm-design: 10x thinking, user-first problem discovery, platform ecosystem leverage, and data-driven iteration
em-lead: Servant leadership, psychological safety, engineering excellence, and multi-team goal alignment

frequentThemes.shape: Design a globally distributed service with low read latency, high write consistency, and resilient partitioning
Describe a scenario where requirements were incomplete or shifting, and you established structure and technical clarity
